_comment: Reviewed advisories for vendored front-end code. Remove an entry once the vendored version no longer has it.
GHSA-cg2g-xh64-v4q7: DOMPurify SAFE_FOR_TEMPLATES bypass. Swagger UI never enables SAFE_FOR_TEMPLATES, and only our own openapi.json is sanitized (queryConfigEnabled is false). Fixed in DOMPurify 3.4.17; no Swagger UI release bundles it yet.
GHSA-mrv2-3pqr-j5jr: DOMPurify IN_PLACE hook issue. Swagger UI never uses IN_PLACE or sanitize hooks. Fixed in DOMPurify 3.4.17.
GHSA-c6gr-qvv4-5v3f: DOMPurify SMIL guard with PARSER_MEDIA_TYPE application/xhtml+xml. Swagger UI uses the default text/html parser. Fixed in DOMPurify 3.4.17.
